paper_title: Searches for electron interactions induced by new physics in the EDELWEISS-III germanium bolometers
notes: Solar CBRD axion search gives g_ae < 1.1e-11 at 90% C.L. in the massless limit (Eq. 11). This is a solar (stellar-source) bound, not a haloscope, so no local DM density is set. The paper also has a mass-dependent bosonic DM ALP g_ae bound (Fig. 5) and hidden photon kinetic mixing bound (DarkPhoton), plus a g_ae*g_aN_eff < 3.5e-17 product from the 57Fe 14.4 keV line, but these are only shown as plots without tabulated values.
